A workbench, not a generic CRM

Versions are part of the evidence

A proposed edit creates
another review.

An assumption change does not inherit approval. Reopen a decision, retain the previous version, and record the reason for reversal.

Inputs & permissions

Permissioned facts
come before connections.

A pilot would need a lawful, maintainable SKU feed. CSV, ERP, and e-commerce inputs are scoping possibilities; production integrations are not claimed.

01

Permissioned sample

Ten historical SKUs and documents shared with appropriate permission, after legal and data review.

02

Named participants

Importer owns the facts, broker reviews the dossier, and counsel handles questions beyond the selected scope.

03

Defined authority

The preview offers local edits and exports. No third-party system writes or external execution.

Privacy choices

Keep diagnostics local.

Optional interaction diagnostics stay in this browser session. No form details or raw product records are recorded, and nothing is transmitted to an analytics provider.
